zh-CN.headlineFact: 贸易、AI、人口与公共系统进入行动窗口
zh-CN.headlineView: 今天检验的是规则如何落进现实
zh-CN.headlineFull: 贸易、AI、人口与公共系统进入行动窗口；今天检验的是规则如何落进现实
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟小包裹关税、谷歌AI设备发布倒计时、单人企业融资、澳大利亚人口普查、马术世锦赛、世界钢鼓日、日全食与赞比亚大选同时进入明确行动窗口。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的执行力，是把复杂变化拆成今天能完成的动作。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 九条时间线，今天都在按下启动键。

en-US.headlineFact: Trade, AI, population and public systems enter action windows
en-US.headlineView: today tests how rules become reality
en-US.headlineFull: Trade, AI, population and public systems enter action windows; today tests how rules become reality
en-US.intro: EU parcel duties, Google's AI-device countdown, solo-business funding, Australia's census, equestrian championships, Steelpan Day, a total eclipse and Zambia's election enter clear action windows.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Execution means turning complex change into actions that can be completed today.
en-US.doudouQuote: Nine timelines are pressing start today.

sources.title: 2026 Census of Population and Housing Census Data Collection Notice

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟3欧元小包裹关税进入运营复盘期
zh-CN.headlineView: HS分类、客单价与合单策略决定利润
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟3欧元小包裹关税进入运营复盘期；HS分类、客单价与合单策略决定利润
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟自7月起对不超过150欧元的低价值进口小包裹按商品类别征收3欧元关税；卖家需复盘首月申报数据、税费展示、拆包方式与本地履约。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境利润表必须把商品分类、税费和履约结构放在一起算。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 同一包裹里多一个品类，成本就可能多一层。

en-US.headlineFact: EU three-euro parcel duty enters its operating review
en-US.headlineView: HS codes, order value and consolidation now shape margin
en-US.headlineFull: EU three-euro parcel duty enters its operating review; HS codes, order value and consolidation now shape margin
en-US.intro: The EU now levies a EUR3 duty per item category in low-value imported parcels up to EUR150; sellers should review first-month declarations, tax display, packing and local fulfillment.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border margin models must calculate classification, tax and fulfillment together.
en-US.doudouQuote: One more category in a parcel can add another cost layer.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Made by Google进入发布前一天
zh-CN.headlineView: 端侧AI从功能清单走向设备系统
zh-CN.headlineFull: Made by Google进入发布前一天；端侧AI从功能清单走向设备系统
zh-CN.intro: Google Store确认Pixel 11系列将于8月12日开放预订并直播新设备发布；市场关注Gemini如何进入手机、穿戴与家庭设备的连续体验。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 端侧AI的竞争，不只看模型参数，更看它能否稳定接住真实场景。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: AI住进每台设备，协同就成了新考题。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: Made by Google enters its final launch day
en-US.headlineView: on-device AI moves from features to a device system
en-US.headlineFull: Made by Google enters its final launch day; on-device AI moves from features to a device system
en-US.intro: Google Store confirms Pixel 11 preorders and a live device launch for August 12, focusing attention on how Gemini connects phones, wearables and home devices.
en-US.xiaziQuote: On-device AI competition is about serving real situations reliably, not model numbers alone.
en-US.doudouQuote: When AI lives in every device, coordination becomes the next test.

sources.title: Google's Pixel 11 launch event is set for August 12

zh-CN.headlineView: 单人企业先把资金用途变成可验证计划
zh-CN.headlineFull: SBA融资课进入最后准备；单人企业先把资金用途变成可验证计划
zh-CN.intro: 美国小企业管理局8月12日线上课将讲解创业与增长贷款、项目匹配及放贷方评估重点；单人经营者可提前整理现金流、用途和偿付路径。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 融资不是先问能借多少，而是先证明每一笔钱如何变成经营结果。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一页清楚的用途表，比一桌工具更接近贷款。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: SBA funding class enters final preparation
en-US.headlineView: solo firms should turn funding needs into a verifiable plan
en-US.headlineFull: SBA funding class enters final preparation; solo firms should turn funding needs into a verifiable plan
en-US.intro: The August 12 SBA webinar covers startup and growth loans, program fit and lender evaluation, giving solo operators a reason to prepare cash flow, use of funds and repayment paths.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Funding starts by proving how each dollar becomes an operating result.
en-US.doudouQuote: A clear use-of-funds page beats a desk full of tools.

sources.title: Wednesday Webinar: SBA Funding for Start-up Businesses

zh-CN.headlineFact: 澳大利亚今晚举行2026人口普查
zh-CN.headlineView: 全国数据将影响服务与资源配置
zh-CN.headlineFull: 澳大利亚今晚举行2026人口普查；全国数据将影响服务与资源配置
zh-CN.intro: 8月11日普查覆盖澳大利亚及相关外岛的每个人与家庭；结果将用于学校、医疗、交通、基础设施、资金分配与选区规划。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 公共决策的精度，来自每个家庭愿意完成的一份真实数据。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一张表很小，却会改变很多城市怎么长大。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：澳大利亚人口。

en-US.headlineView: national data will shape services and resources
en-US.headlineFull: Australia holds its 2026 Census tonight; national data will shape services and resources
en-US.intro: The August 11 Census includes every person and household in Australia and related islands, informing schools, health care, transport, infrastructure, funding and electoral boundaries.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Precise public decisions begin with truthful data from each household.
en-US.doudouQuote: One small form can change how many cities grow.

sources.title: 2026 Census of Population and Housing Census Data Collection Notice

zh-CN.headlineFact: 世界马术锦标赛今日在亚琛开幕
zh-CN.headlineView: 多项目赛程考验人马协作与城市运营
zh-CN.headlineFull: 世界马术锦标赛今日在亚琛开幕；多项目赛程考验人马协作与城市运营
zh-CN.intro: 2026 FEI世界锦标赛于8月11日至23日在德国亚琛举行，盛装舞步率先开赛，随后展开场地障碍、三项赛、残障盛装舞步、马车与轻驾。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 顶级竞技的背后，是训练、动物福利、场馆与转播的共同系统。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 人和马一起赢，后台也要一起稳。

en-US.headlineFact: FEI World Championships open in Aachen today
en-US.headlineView: multiple disciplines test horse-rider and city operations
en-US.headlineFull: FEI World Championships open in Aachen today; multiple disciplines test horse-rider and city operations
en-US.intro: The August 11-23 championships open with dressage in Aachen, followed by jumping, eventing, para dressage, driving and vaulting.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Elite sport depends on training, animal welfare, venues and broadcasting working together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Horse and rider win together; the operation must stay steady too.

zh-CN.headlineView: 加勒比创新连接文化、教育与社区
zh-CN.headlineFull: 世界钢鼓日今天响起；加勒比创新连接文化、教育与社区
zh-CN.intro: 联合国将8月11日定为世界钢鼓日，强调这一源自特立尼达和多巴哥的乐器对文化多样性、创意经济、青年赋权与可持续社区的价值。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 文化遗产真正有生命力，是能继续创造工作、连接和新的表达。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一只旧油桶，也能被敲成整个社区的声音。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：文化与创意经济。

en-US.headlineView: Caribbean innovation links culture, learning and community
en-US.headlineFull: World Steelpan Day sounds today; Caribbean innovation links culture, learning and community
en-US.intro: The UN marks August 11 as World Steelpan Day, highlighting the Trinidad and Tobago instrument's value to cultural diversity, the creative economy, youth empowerment and sustainable communities.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Living heritage keeps creating work, connection and new expression.
en-US.doudouQuote: An old oil drum can become the voice of a whole community.

sources.title: General Assembly proclaims 11 August as World Steelpan Day

zh-CN.headlineFact: 8月12日日全食进入最后一天倒计时
zh-CN.headlineView: 安全观测与交通预案来到执行时刻
zh-CN.headlineFull: 8月12日日全食进入最后一天倒计时；安全观测与交通预案来到执行时刻
zh-CN.intro: 全食带将经过格陵兰、冰岛、俄罗斯北部、西班牙与葡萄牙一角；更广区域可见偏食，观测者需核对合格滤镜、路线、天气与人流安排。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 稀有天象越壮观，安全、路线和天气预案越要具体。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 抬头看太阳之前，先把合格观测镜戴好。

en-US.headlineFact: August 12 total solar eclipse enters its final-day countdown
en-US.headlineView: safe viewing and travel plans reach execution time
en-US.headlineFull: August 12 total solar eclipse enters its final-day countdown; safe viewing and travel plans reach execution time
en-US.intro: Totality crosses Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, Spain and a corner of Portugal; wider regions see a partial eclipse, requiring certified filters, routes, weather and crowd plans.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The rarer the spectacle, the more concrete safety, routes and weather plans must be.
en-US.doudouQuote: Before looking at the Sun, put on certified eclipse viewers.

sources.title: The Government launches the official website with information on the three eclipse events

zh-CN.headlineFact: 赞比亚国家计票流程进入最后准备
zh-CN.headlineFull: 赞比亚国家计票流程进入最后准备；8月13日大选进入最后准备
zh-CN.intro: 赞比亚8月13日举行总统、议会与地方选举投票；选举委员会说明总统结果将由国家计票中心接收并公布，认证、投票站与结果流程进入最后准备。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 选举可信度来自每个具体环节都清楚、可追踪、可验证。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 选票很小，背后的流程必须足够清楚。

en-US.headlineFact: Zambia's national results process enters final preparation
en-US.headlineView: the August 13 election enters final preparation
en-US.headlineFull: Zambia's national results process enters final preparation; the August 13 election enters final preparation
en-US.intro: Zambia votes in presidential, parliamentary and local elections on August 13; the Electoral Commission explains that presidential results are received and announced through the national results centre as final preparations proceed.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Election credibility comes from every step being clear, traceable and verifiable.
en-US.doudouQuote: A ballot is small; the process behind it must be clear.

sources.title: Elections and the National Results Centre
About the EU Election Observation Mission Zambia 2026
